Callout.Name: Transfer Escort Request
Callout.Message: Escort requested for a transfer to court.
Callout.Advisory: Inmate ready, vehicle waiting, route clear.

Script.Line: Court in the morning. It has to be a two unit escort.
He has been violent twice this month. Both times in the van.
If it is one unit I am not moving him. That is the end of it.

Lines.Approach: He is ready and the vehicle is waiting. They will not move without a second unit.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
